# Install packes
```{r}
# Set up renv for package management
if (!requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("renv")
} else {
    message("renv is already installed.")
}

# Load the renv package
library(renv)

# Check if renv is already active, activate if not
if (!renv::status()$synchronized) {
    renv::activate()
}

# To restore the environment (for a collaborator)
renv::restore()

# Load the required libraries
library(terra)
library(Spatial.align)
library(rasterVis)
```

# Load the data
```{r}
# Parish boundaries
parish_boundaries = vect("C:/Users/rikib/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/Processed/Adm_boundaries_parishes/Parishes_Kamp_UTM36N.shp")

land_cover <- rast("C:/Users/rikib/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/Landcover/terrascope_download_20240305_144418/ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N00E030_Map/ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N00E030_Map.tif")

health_facilities <- vect("C:/Users/rikib/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/Facilities/suhsharan_health_facilities_UG/UG_HF_all.shp")

dem <- rast("C:/Users/rikib/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/DEM/Uganda_SRTM30m/Uganda_SRTM30meters.tif")
```

# Align the data
```{r}
# Align the land cover data to the parish boundaries
land_cover <- align(land_cover, parish_boundaries, show_plot = FALSE)

# Align the health facilities data to the parish boundaries
health_facilities <- align(health_facilities, parish_boundaries, show_plot = FALSE)

# Align the DEM data to the parish boundaries
dem <- align(dem, parish_boundaries, show_plot = FALSE)
contour_lines <- terra::as.contour(dem, levels = seq(minmax(dem)[1], minmax(dem)[2], by = 50))  # Contour interval set to 50

```

# Plot the data
```{r}
# Plot using GGplot
ggplot() +
  # Plot parish boundaries with transparent fill and black borders
  geom_sf(data = parish_boundaries, fill = "transparent", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  # Plot health facilities with red color
  geom_sf(data = health_facilities, aes(color = "Health Facilities"), size = 2) +
  # Define custom color for health facilities
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Health Facilities" = "red")) +
  # Add labels and titles
  labs(
    title = "Spatial Distribution of Health Facilities in Kampala",
    subtitle = "Aligned with Parish Boundaries",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    caption = "Data Source: PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility"
  ) +
  # Apply minimal theme
  theme_minimal() +
  # Customize theme elements
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),  # Center and style title
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),  # Center subtitle
    legend.position = "bottom",  # Position legend at the bottom
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),  # Style legend title
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)  # Style legend text
  )

# Plot with landcover data and healthcare facilities, and legend placed inside the plot
autoplot(land_cover, alpha = 0.6) +  # Set opacity to 60%
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    colours = c(
      "10" = "#006400",  # Tree cover
      "20" = "#FFBB22",  # Shrubland
      "30" = "#FFFF4C",  # Grassland
      "40" = "#F096FF",  # Cropland
      "50" = "#FA0000",  # Built-up
      "60" = "#B4B4B4",  # Bare / sparse vegetation
      "70" = "#F0F0F0",  # Snow and Ice
      "80" = "#0064C8",  # Permanent water bodies
      "90" = "#009696",  # Herbaceous wetland
      "95" = "#00CF75",  # Mangroves
      "100" = "#FAE6A0"  # Moss and lichen
    ),  # Use the specified color palette
    name = "Landcover Categories",  # Improved legend title
    limits = c(10, 100),  # Set limits for the color scale
    breaks = c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 95, 100),  # Custom breaks
    labels = c(
      "Tree cover", 
      "Shrubland", 
      "Grassland", 
      "Cropland", 
      "Built-up", 
      "Bare / sparse \nvegetation", 
      "Snow and Ice", 
      "Permanent water \nbodies", 
      "Herbaceous \nwetland", 
      "Mangroves", 
      "Moss and lichen"
    ),  # Custom legend labels
    na.value = "transparent"  # Set NA values to transparent
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = contour_lines, color = "black", size = 0.3) +  # Add DEM contour lines directly
  geom_sf(data = health_facilities, aes(color = "Health Facilities"), shape = 23, size = 6, fill = "blue") +  # Changed shape and added fill
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Health Facilities" = "red")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.02, 0.15),  # Position legend inside the plot (adjust as needed)
    legend.justification = "left",  # Align legend at the specified position
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),  # Increase legend title font size
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),  # Increase legend label font size
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),  # Adjust width of legend keys (smaller)
    legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "cm"),  # Adjust height of legend keys (smaller)
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, 'cm'),  # Adjust spacing between legend items
    legend.box = "vertical",  # Stack the legends vertically
    legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),  # Add box around the legend
    axis.text = element_blank(),  # Remove axis text
    axis.title = element_blank(),  # Remove axis titles
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80", size = 0.5),  # Add major gridlines
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.25),  # Add minor gridlines
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),  # Add white background to facet labels
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold"),  # Center and enlarge title
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)  # Add a box around the plot
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(title.position = "top", nrow = 7, byrow = TRUE),  # Move legend title to top and arrange items
    color = guide_legend(title = NULL)  # Remove the "colour" title for Health Facilities
  ) +
  ggtitle("Landcover Map of Kampala with Health Facilities")


```
